remarks: Beautifully sited gracious Colonial in great South Wilton location. Drive up the elegant entrance and enjoy the beautiful grounds creating a stately presence to this four bedroom home. Light and bright home with wonderful flow. Sun drenched living room with fireplace leads directly into large formal dining room off kitchen for easy entertaining. Lovely updated kitchen with its own eat in area/seating. Kitchen opens to great family room with second fireplace and access to deck for excellent outdoor entertaining. Large room over garage can serve multi purposes including home office, playroom, movie room..... Large unfinished basement with high ceilings has great potential to finish for additional living space. An abundance of windows and light make for a very sun filled happy home!
